notes: ح gives two branches: the first is Abu Bakr through Ali b. Mushir and Ibn Fudayl to Mukhtar; the second is Ali b. Hajar (the wording is his, واللفظ له) through Ali b. Mushir to Mukhtar b. Fulful. Anas is written once after the last ح, so it is the shared tail. The gloss واللفظ له is left out.
